form.label: Status
form.description: Collector health per input: last run, devices and samples per run, errors, and what reached the index. Collector logs come from index _internal; events from the index entered below (* = all indexes, slower). Self-contained: this XML also works pasted into a classic dashboard on a search head without the add-on.

search.query: | tstats count where index=_internal sourcetype="airwatch:gps:log" by source | rex field=source "airwatch_gps_(?<input>[^/]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | stats sum(count) as count by input | sort input

index=_internal sourcetype="airwatch:gps:log" source="*airwatch_gps_$input$.log*" | rex field=source "airwatch_gps_(?<input>[^/]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL) (?<message>.*)" | rex field=message "^run done: devices (?<devices>\d+) \((?<pages>\d+) pages\), samples (?<samples>\d+), new (?<new>\d+), repeated (?<repeated>\d+), without device (?<without_device>\d+), without location (?<without_location>\d+), splunk (?<splunk>\d+), cef (?<cef>\d+).*?, window (?<window_start>\S+)\.\.(?<window_end>\S+), took (?<took_sec>[\d.]+) s" | eval run_time=if(isnotnull(new), _time, null()), err_time=if(log_level IN ("ERROR","CRITICAL"), _time, null()), err=if(log_level IN ("ERROR","CRITICAL"), message, null()) | stats max(run_time) as last_run count(run_time) as runs latest(devices) as devices latest(samples) as samples latest(new) as new latest(repeated) as repeated latest(without_device) as without_device latest(without_location) as without_location latest(splunk) as to_splunk latest(cef) as to_cef latest(took_sec) as took_sec latest(window_start) as window_start max(err_time) as err_time latest(err) as last_error by input | eval status=case(isnotnull(err_time) AND err_time>=coalesce(last_run,0), "ERROR", isnull(last_run), "NO RUN YET", now()-last_run>7500, "NO RUN IN 2 H", true(), "OK") | eval last_run=strftime(last_run, "%F %T"), last_error=if(status="ERROR", last_error, null()) | table input status last_run runs devices samples new repeated without_device without_location to_splunk to_cef took_sec window_start last_error | sort input

index=_internal sourcetype="airwatch:gps:log" source="*airwatch_gps_$input$.log*" "run done" | rex field=source "airwatch_gps_(?<input>[^/]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "run done: devices \d+ \(\d+ pages\), samples \d+, new (?<new>\d+)," | timechart sum(new) by input

index=_internal sourcetype="airwatch:gps:log" source="*airwatch_gps_$input$.log*" "run done" | rex field=source "airwatch_gps_(?<input>[^/]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex ", took (?<took_sec>[\d.]+) s" | timechart max(took_sec) by input

index=_internal sourcetype="airwatch:gps:log" source="*airwatch_gps_$input$.log*" ("run done" OR "run failed" OR "skipped" OR "older samples") | rex field=source "airwatch_gps_(?<input>[^/]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>[A-Z]+) (?<message>.*)" | table _time input log_level message | sort - _time

index=_internal sourcetype="airwatch:gps:log" source="*airwatch_gps_$input$.log*" (WARNING OR ERROR OR CRITICAL) | rex field=source "airwatch_gps_(?<input>[^/]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL) (?<message>.*)" | search log_level IN (WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL) | eval pattern=replace(message, "\d+", "N") | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen latest(message) as latest_example by input log_level pattern | sort - last_seen | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | table input log_level count last_seen latest_example

panel.title: Indexed samples per hour, by console (host)

search.query: | tstats count where index="$idx$" sourcetype="airwatch:gps" by _time host span=1h | timechart span=1h sum(count) by host

index="$idx$" sourcetype="airwatch:gps" | eval age_min=(_indextime-_time)/60 | stats count as samples avg(age_min) as avg_age_min perc95(age_min) as p95_age_min max(_indextime) as newest_indexed by host | eval avg_age_min=round(avg_age_min, 1), p95_age_min=round(p95_age_min, 1), newest_indexed=strftime(newest_indexed, "%F %T") | table host samples avg_age_min p95_age_min newest_indexed

panel.title: Splunk messages about the inputs (start-up and script errors)

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd (component=ExecProcessor OR component=ModularInputs) "airwatch_gps" log_level!=INFO | eval message=coalesce(event_message, _raw) | table _time host log_level component message | sort - _time

panel.title: Changes made on the Inputs page

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="airwatch:gps:webapi" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>[A-Z]+) (?<message>.*)" | table _time host log_level message | sort - _time
